changes.before: 하지만 충격이 커서 공기실이 거의 납작해지면, 가둔 공기 외에 무엇이 화물을 한 번 더 막아 줄까요?
changes.after: 하지만 충격이 커서 공기실이 거의 납작해지면, 가둔 공기 외에 무엇이 화물을 충격으로부터 한 번 더 보호해 줄까요?
changes.reason: The source asks what else can shield the goods from impact. In “무엇이 화물을 … 막아 줄까요?”, 화물을 becomes the thing being blocked, so the Korean can mean stopping the cargo itself. Make protection from impact explicit while retaining the near-flattening condition and source clause order.

changes.before: El relieve de pared empieza a recibir fuerzas por la carga; cuando la patente recogió este giro, ¿ya existía la empresa?
changes.after: El relieve de pared empieza a absorber los golpes para proteger la carga; cuando la patente recogió este giro, ¿ya existía la empresa?
changes.reason: “Recibir fuerzas por la carga” is unnatural and leaves por la carga open to a causal reading: forces caused by the cargo. The source says that the former wall pattern now takes force on the cargo’s behalf. State that protective purpose clearly, keeping the company-founding question second.

changes.before: Si llevas la mesa de embalaje, recibes más que un rollo: sumas un paso de inflado que debe seguir el ritmo de los envíos.
changes.after: Si estás a cargo de la mesa de embalaje, recibes más que un rollo: sumas un paso de inflado que debe seguir el ritmo de los envíos.
changes.reason: “Si llevas la mesa de embalaje” can mean carrying the packing table and is not a natural way to assign responsibility for a packing station. The source condition is that the viewer is in charge of that station; retain the added inflation step and its coordination with shipment pace.
